_comment: What a pilot has room for, by level (common/src/econ/unlocks.ts): base is what everyone starts with, levels adds to it from that level on ({ "15": 1 } = one more from level 15). The level-up message names what opened. Milestones only: none of this changes a ship's numbers.
_complexityComment: complexity is a build-point budget (common/src/ships/grades.ts buildPoints): each cell costs 1 (Mk I), 1.6, 2.5, 3.8 or 5.5 (Mk V). A ship built from a plan builds as designed.
